summary: Shows the append_rp and prepend_rp results and an example using recursive=True together with list_merge='append_rp' on nested data.
questions: What does prepend_rp do in combine?
Can I use recursive and list_merge together?

answer_card.title: append_rp, prepend_rp and combining options
answer_card.answer_md:
With left `[1,1,2,3]` and right `[3,4,5,5]`:
- `append_rp` gives `[1,1,2,3,4,5,5]`
- `prepend_rp` gives `[3,4,5,5,1,1,2]`

Both options together:

```jinja
{{ default | combine(patch, recursive=True, list_merge='append_rp') }}
```

This merges nested dicts and appends lists without duplicating shared items.
